verdict.rationale: A SaaS email product could plausibly publish an interactive API reference, so this axis applies. The evidence contains no API reference, developer portal, or runnable examples, and probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404. The documented MCP server lets AI assistants drive the inbox, but it is a different capability and does not count as an explorable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
